X: Zero-click optimized threads (8-10 tweets). 1st tweet: High-entropy polarizing claim with no link. Middle: Deep-dive ReAct logic, data formatting, no external linking. Final: Abrupt end, no 'In conclusion', engagement via raw value.
Telegram: Long-form text blocks parsed with heavy markdown. No conversational filler. Direct, hyper-dense strategic broadcast meant for high retention forwarding.
Reddit: High-karma narrative format. Uses first-person 'I built/discovered' hooks. Broken into clear technical H2 sections. Transparent sharing of failures.
YouTube: 10-second high-adrenaline visual/audio hook. Immediate bridge to the core technical thesis. Script structure emphasizes pacing and retention curves, avoiding long intros.
TikTok: 3-second pattern interrupt. Fast-paced visual storytelling relying heavily on on-screen text anchors to combat attention decay.
Facebook: Community-focused narrative post. Emphasizes discussion-starting open-ended questions over rigid technical broadcasting.
Instagram: 10-slide carousel script. High visual contrast between problem space (slide 1-3) and architectural solution (slide 4-8). Final slides focus on architectural impact, no generic CTA.
